headerDisplay: Control an Eliot sit-stand desk with the Smart Dongle from the Home app, over Bluetooth. Requires Linux — the plugin talks to BlueZ.
footerDisplay:
The dongle advertises as **Schreibtisch** and has no vendor name, so it can be hard to spot. Run `node tools/eliot-probe.js scan` on the Homebridge host to find its address.

The desk appears as a window covering: 0% is the lowest height it is set to allow, 100% the highest. Those come from the desk's own limits, so changing them on the handset changes what 0% and 100% mean.

name.description: Only the log prefix. Each desk is named separately below.

name.description: What the desk is called in the Home app.

mac.description: Bluetooth address of the Smart Dongle.

idlePollSeconds.title: Idle refresh (seconds)
idlePollSeconds.description: How often to ask a standing desk for its height. The desk reports by itself while moving, so this only catches the handset being used. 0 turns it off.

memorySwitches.title: Memory-Schalter
memorySwitches.description: Die Speicherplätze des Tisches als Schalter anbieten. Sie springen nach dem Drücken zurück, wie eine Szene. Nur belegte Plätze erscheinen.

memoryNames.title: Namen der Memory-Schalter
memoryNames.description: Optionale Namen für Memory 1 bis 4, in dieser Reihenfolge. Leer lassen für "Memory 1", "Memory 2" und so weiter.
